tools.name: docs
tools.title: Cloudflare Docs Search
tools.description:
Search the Cloudflare documentation.

		This tool should be used to answer any question about Cloudflare products or features, including:
		- Workers, Pages, R2, Images, Stream, D1, Durable Objects, KV, Workflows, Hyperdrive, Queues
		- AI Search, Workers AI, Vectorize, AI Gateway, Browser Rendering
		- Zero Trust, Access, Tunnel, Gateway, Browser Isolation, WARP, DDOS, Magic Transit, Magic WAN
		- CDN, Cache, DNS, Zaraz, Argo, Rulesets, Terraform, Account and Billing

		Results are returned as semantically similar chunks to the query.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Cloudflare API Spec Search

code.description: JavaScript async arrow function to search the OpenAPI spec

truncate.description: Cap the result at ~6,000 tokens. Set to false only when the result goes straight to a file or pipe, not into the conversation: without the cap, a broad query can return megabytes.

account_id.description: Cloudflare account ID to run against. Optional when the session is authorized for exactly one account, and for account-independent calls such as GET /accounts.

tools.name: whoami
tools.title: Current Cloudflare Identity
tools.description: Return the Cloudflare user or account that this connection is authenticated as. Takes no arguments. The id is stable across token refresh, reconnection and permission changes.

id.description: Opaque profile identifier. Unique within this server, unchanged across token refresh, reconnection, and display-metadata changes. Never reassigned to another profile.

name.description: Display name for the authenticated profile.

email.description: Email address for display; not used as the profile identity.
